correctness.rationale: The symmetric Dirichlet conditional law given minimum u and its minimizer has residual simplex density proportional to ∏[u+(1−mu)Y_i]^(alpha−1). For alpha=1 the residual is uniform independent of u and q_t(u)=(t−u)/(1−mu) has derivative (mt−1)/(1−mu)^2: stochastic order reverses across t=1/m, and at critical t the exceedance count is independent of u. Extreme u values eliminate all off-critical thresholds for all alpha. Near u=1/m, normalized density expansion has first nonconstant contribution −(alpha−1)m^4 h²/2 Cov(N,Q); direct beta integration gives negative Cov=−(m−2)(m−1)^(m−1)/m^(m+1), proving nonzero quadratic coefficient for alpha≠1. Independently integrated rational Dirichlet moments for m=3..12. Original auxiliary covariance-sign claim was untrue for a globally nonconstant g that is constant on support of Z (e.g. g(x)=max(0,x−1/m)); full RESULT.md is repaired to require g(Z) nonconstant a.s., preserving all substantive theorems, proofs and covariances.
residual_risks: Finite tests alone are not a universal proof.
